source_row.stem: A hospital's formal alarm management program typically includes:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Disabling most alarms across the entire nursing unit as the primary chosen strategy for reducing overall ambient background noise levels heard","B":"Applying mainly to cardiac telemetry monitors, with less consideration given to any other type of alarmed equipment on the unit","C":"Establishing alarm priorities across the unit, individualizing parameters where clinically appropriate, and providing ongoing staff education to help reduce alarm fatigue","D":"Consisting of fairly few specific defined elements or structured components across the entire hospital-wide alarm safety program initiative overall"}}
source_row.rationale: Formal alarm management programs typically include establishing alarm priorities, individualizing parameters where clinically appropriate, and ongoing staff education, addressing the National Patient Safety Goal on alarm safety.
source_row.source_name: The Joint Commission — Alarm Management National Patient Safety Goal
